SIDEOUT MMRDOUBLES

Finding your level

Your rating starts at 1200. Every recorded win earns 20–40 points, based on the average rating of each duo.

0 games0 wins

Sideout is its own rating system. Both teammates earn the same win points. The losing duo loses the corresponding amount, with a minimum player rating of 100.

HOW YOUR RATING MOVES

Good games count.

Beat a much lower-rated duo+20
Beat an evenly matched duo+30
Beat a much higher-rated duo+40

One player records the result. All four ratings update together, and each game counts once.

EVERY GAME HAS ITS WEIGHT

A fair match.
A fair rating.

The two player ratings form your team average. Wins add 20–40 MMR. Beat a stronger duo and earn more points; beat a lower rated duo and earn fewer. The losing duo loses the winner’s gain.

Favorites winSmaller gain ↗Underdogs winBigger gain ↗
